info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Servicing Customer Case Managements-spec
info.description: The Servicing Customer Case Managements API enables users to retrieve information about customer case management activities related to banking services. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can access detailed data regarding ongoing and resolved customer cases, ensuring efficient handling of customer inquiries and issues. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and banking application developers who need to integrate case management functionalities into their systems. This API supports the operational needs of customer support teams by streamlining access to essential case data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details of customer cases managed within the servicing system, providing insights into the current status and relevant information associated with each case.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving customer case management operations. It contains specific parameters required to filter or paginate through customer case management entries.

200.description: Successfully retrieved customer case management data.
